## Summary
What changed and why?

## Type of change
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Performance improvement
- [ ] Test coverage
- [ ] Documentation / tooling

## Validation
Describe how the change was tested or reproduced.

## Risk
What could regress, and what related paths were checked?

## Checklist
- [ ] Change is focused and reviewable.
- [ ] Tests/build checks pass for affected code.
- [ ] Public behavior or docs are updated when needed.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or private data are included.
